o.text: From Proto-Common Turkic *tuman, a derivative of the verbal stem Proto-Common Turkic *tuma-, *tum- (“to envelop”).
From Russian шедевр (šedevr), ultimately from French chef-d'œuvre.

From Proto-Common Turkic *özelen-, a derivation of Proto-Common Turkic *öze-, proposed to be from Proto-Turkic *öŕē- (“to burn”, intr.), as reflected in Chuvash вӗре (vĕre, “to boil, to be hot”). The ultimate origin is proposed to be from Proto-Indo-European *wer- (“to burn”), via Proto-Tocharian *u̯ʲər-.
